# semaphore_ex_global_credential (Resource)

Manages a global Semaphore EX credential without reading credential material from the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_global_credential" "deployment_token" {
  type             = "string"
  display_name     = "Deployment token"
  value_wo         = var.deployment_token
  value_wo_version = 1
}
```

- `type` (String)

### Optional

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell

```
